sentences.en: There are a few nuclear bomb shelters in the city.
sentences.zh: 这个城市有几个核弹掩体。

sentences.en: This kind of bomb is a serious menace to mankind.
sentences.zh: 这种炸弹是对人类的一大威胁。

sentences.en: The area the center of which is here was bombed.
sentences.zh: 这里为中心区域的地方遭到了轰炸。

senses.zh: 炸弹，高压罐，火山口喷出的熔岩
